feedback_text: The lecturer explains difficult topics clearly and gives useful examples.
I really enjoy the lectures because the instructor is well prepared.
The teacher encourages questions and gives helpful answers.
Course materials are organized and easy to understand.
The lecturer provides timely feedback on assignments.
The teaching methods make the subject interesting.
The instructor is knowledgeable and supportive.
Practical demonstrations help me understand the lessons.
The laboratory has modern equipment for our experiments.
Lab assistants are friendly and help students when needed.
The computers in the laboratory work smoothly.
There are enough tools for students during practical sessions.
The library is clean and has comfortable study spaces.
Classrooms are spacious and have good lighting.
The campus internet connection is reliable.
The university provides clean drinking water and restrooms.
The administration responds quickly to student requests.
Registration procedures are simple and clearly explained.
Staff members are polite and provide accurate information.
Exam schedules are announced early enough.
The lecturer often arrives late and does not cover the syllabus.
Lessons are confusing because the instructor does not explain concepts.
The teacher rarely answers questions from students.
Assignment feedback takes too long to arrive.
Most laboratory computers are broken and cannot run the required software.
There is not enough equipment for everyone to complete experiments.
The laboratory is poorly maintained and lacks essential materials.
Practical sessions are frequently cancelled without notice.
The classrooms are overcrowded and uncomfortable.
The campus Wi-Fi is very slow and disconnects frequently.
The toilets are dirty and there are not enough study spaces.
The library closes too early for students who study after class.
The registration process is confusing and takes too much time.
Administrative staff do not respond to emails or questions.
Important announcements are shared too late.
It takes several weeks to receive official documents.
The lecture starts at the scheduled time and follows the course outline.
The instructor uses slides and a textbook during the lessons.
The laboratory is open on weekdays from morning until afternoon.
Students use the available computers for practical assignments.
The university has classrooms, a library, and a cafeteria.
The campus has parking areas near the main buildings.
The administration office is located on the ground floor.
Students submit registration forms to the academic office.
The lecturer gives homework at the end of some classes.
The lab timetable is displayed on the department notice board.
The library provides books for different academic departments.
The academic office publishes examination dates each semester.
